models.notes: Clause 1 warrants the vehicle 'Inclusive of Battery and Electric Powertrain' for 3 years or 1,25,000 km, whichever is earlier. Clause 7 excludes 'any inherent normal deterioration of the car or any of its parts arising from the actual use of the car', which by clause 1's wording reaches the battery, but it does not name capacity, so this is recorded as NOT_STATED and not EXCLUDED.
